notes: PARENTS CORRECTED; "QUAKER" LABEL LIKELY ANACHRONISTIC (research 2026-07-03): compiled Bull genealogies (Ancestry; WikiTree Bull-1602) consistently give his parents as WILLIAM BULL (no title) and ELIZABETH WORTHINGTON, not "Sir WILLIAM Knight Bull (Quaker)" and "Elisabeth BULL" as this tree has it (I182567600333 / I182567600325). WikiTree dates the father 1564-1635, decades before the Quaker movement was founded (George Fox, early 1650s) — the "(Quaker)" descriptor is very likely a later, undocumented embellishment. Recommend dropping "Sir," "Knight," and "(Quaker)," and correcting the mother's name to Elizabeth Worthington.
